name: Roland-Garros 2027
job: Explain the opening and final phases and date-sensitive outside-court terms, while separating individual ticket sales from hospitality and travel packages.
source_notes: Organiser travel terms date the tournament 17 May–6 June and final phase 23 May–6 June. Outside-court definition changes on 30 May and 1 June for the specific terms. September 2026 notice says individual tickets not yet on sale; current status must be checked.
